choices.content: For some points, it equals the diameter
It equals the radius for every point
It can be any positive number

question.prompt:
What is the distance from any point on the surface of a sphere to its center?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h106_q3_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: A sphere is the set of points whose distance from a fixed point equals the radius.
solutions.title: Using the definition of a sphere
